blocks.text: Biostatistics shumariyati (statistical) tareeqe hayati, tibbi aur sehat ke data par lagati hai. Is mein bamaani nataij nikalne ke liye data jama karna, pesh karna, tajziya aur tashreeh shamil hai. Yeh tehqeeq karne walon aur sehat ke mahireen ko sample data se poori aabadi ke baare mein soche samjhe faisle karne deti hai, poori aabadi ko test karne ke bajaye jo mushkil ya mehnga ho sakta hai. Maslan mazdooron ke numainda hisse ka mutala kar ke biostatistics andaza lagane mein madad deti hai ke sab mazdooron mein koi bimari kitni aam hai.

blocks.prompt: Tehqeeq karne wale poori aabadi ke bajaye sample kyun parhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Poori aabadi ko test karna aksar mushkil ya mehnga hota hai; numainda sample se aabadi ki khasiyaton ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.

items: Biostatistics: hayati aur sehat ke data par statistics.
Aabadi ke faislon ke liye samples use hote hain.
